function: no_learning: GN-BL estimates the near-field XL-MIMO channel with iterative EM and gradient descent run on each observation, with no trained model (p. 3, p. 5).
notes: Excluded as no_learning. GN-BL is sparse Bayesian learning solved by EM (p. 3) and gradient descent (p. 4); Algorithm 1 (p. 5) only iterates I1=25 and I2=20 times per observation, with no training data, network or trained parameters; all compared estimators (P-SOMP, P-SIGW, NF-OGSBL, MOMP, NNCE, VBL) are iterative algorithms too (p. 5). Dictionary learning and Bayesian learning in the abstract (p. 1) name statistical estimation, not a trained model. Title and DOI on p. 1 match.
